integrity: Theorem for at most five pairs has an analytic proof; the six-pair witness is checked by two separate 720-permutation enumerators and the three-pair sanity regression covers 46,656 profiles. Independently audited status is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Complete strict, one-to-one balanced marriage only; no guarantee for incomplete lists, ties, capacities, non-rank utilities, or all larger markets. Novelty remains subject to independent priority search.
title: Six pairs are the sharp boundary for compatibility of minimum-regret and minimum-rank-gap stable marriage
